order_status.description: Customer asks where an order is, its status, ETA, or tracking state.

delivery_delay.description: A delivery is late or the customer reports a missed expected delivery date.

missing_delivery.description: The carrier/order says delivered but the customer did not receive the package.

refund.description: Customer asks about a refund, refund timing, or a refund that has not appeared.

return.description: Customer wants to return an item or asks about the return process/eligibility.

cancellation.description: Customer wants to cancel an order or asks whether an order can be cancelled.

payment_issue.description: Payment, charge, card, billing, or checkout problem.

account_issue.description: Login, password, account access, account settings, or identity-related support.

subscription_prime.description: Prime membership, Prime renewal, Prime benefits, or Prime billing.

product_issue.description: Problem with a received product, damaged/wrong item, or product-specific issue.

other.description: General help, thanks, unclear messages, or issues that do not fit another intent.
